title: Credit Guarantee Scheme for MSMEs
detail: 60% guarantee on loans up to ₹100 crore for MSME equipment purchases; total guarantee cap of ₹7 lakh crore.

title: Collateral-Free Agricultural Loans — limit raised
detail: RBI raised the collateral-free farm loan ceiling from ₹1.6 lakh to ₹2 lakh per borrower.

title: NPS Vatsalya — Pension Scheme for Minors
detail: National Pension System extended to minors (below 18); minimum ₹1,000 to open, transitions to regular NPS at 18.

title: UPI Incentive Scheme for Low-Value Transactions
detail: 0.15% incentive per P2M transaction up to ₹2,000 to promote digital payments among small merchants.

title: MSP for Kharif & Rabi Crops 2024-25
detail: Assured procurement prices increased across crops — paddy +5%, tur +8%, wheat +6.6%, nigerseed +13%.

title: PM Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
detail: Continuation of Price Support, Price Stabilisation Fund, Price Deficit Payment & Market Intervention schemes.

title: Nutrient Based Subsidy on Fertilisers
detail: Subsidy on P&K fertilisers for Rabi 2024 and Kharif 2025.

title: Clean Plant Programme
detail: 9 Clean Plant Centres for virus-free planting material; certification under Seeds Act.

title: National Mission on Edible Oils — Oilseeds
detail: Raise primary oilseed production from 39 MT to 70 MT by 2030-31; 65 new seed hubs.

title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund — Expansion
detail: AIF expanded to cover community farming assets and integrated processing projects.

title: Credit Guarantee Scheme for e-NWR Pledge Financing
detail: Guarantee cover of 75-85% on loans against electronic negotiable warehousing receipts.

title: National Mission on Natural Farming
detail: 15,000 clusters, 1 crore farmers, 7.5 lakh hectares; 30,000 Krishi Sakhis deployed.

title: PM-RKVY & Krishonnati Yojana (Rationalised)
detail: Two umbrella schemes for sustainable agriculture and food security.

title: Free Fortified Rice under PMGKAY (Extended)
detail: Free supply of micronutrient-enriched rice extended from July 2024 to December 2028.

title: Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme
detail: Incentives for domestic electronics component manufacturing and global value chains.

title: New Industrial Corridor Nodes
detail: 12 new smart industrial cities across 10 states under National Industrial Corridor Programme.

title: Diamond Imprest Authorisation Scheme
detail: Duty-free import of small natural diamonds for qualifying exporters.

title: Ethanol Interest Subvention for Cooperative Sugar Mills
detail: 6% interest subvention for 5 years for conversion to multi-feedstock ethanol plants.

title: BioE3 Policy — High-Performance Biomanufacturing
detail: Innovation support for bio-based R&D; Bio-AI hubs and Biofoundry establishment.

title: ₹1,000 Crore VC Fund for Space Startups
detail: INSPACe venture capital fund; ₹150-200 crore/year over 2025-30.

title: Viability Gap Funding for Offshore Wind Energy
detail: 1 GW offshore wind (500 MW each off Gujarat & Tamil Nadu); port upgrades.

title: Model Solar Village Scheme
detail: ₹1 crore per district to solarise one village via competition under PM-Surya Ghar Yojana.

title: Green Hydrogen Production Incentive (SIGHT Tranche-II)
detail: 4,50,000 MT capacity allocation via bidding; incentive up to ₹50/kg declining over 3 years.

title: PM JI-VAN Yojana Modifications
detail: Extended 5 years; expanded to support second-gen ethanol from agricultural residues and algae.

title: PMGSY-IV — Rural Roads
detail: 62,500 km roads connecting 25,000 unconnected habitations over 5 years.

title: PMAY — Gramin Continuation
detail: 2 crore additional pucca houses; ₹1.20-1.30 lakh per house.

title: PM Vidyalakshmi — Student Loans
detail: Collateral-free loans for students in top-ranked institutions; 3% interest subvention.

title: Vigyan Dhara Scheme
detail: Merges 3 R&D schemes; research labs, transnational collaboration, women in science.

title: PM Janjatiya Unnat Gram Abhiyan
detail: 25 interventions across 63,000 villages covering housing, roads, water, health, education.

title: National Forensic Infrastructure Enhancement Scheme
detail: NFSU campuses, Central Forensic Science Laboratories; target >90% conviction rate.

title: PM Internship Scheme — Pilot
detail: 1.25 lakh internships in top-500 CSR companies; ₹5,000/month stipend.

title: Skill India Programme Continuation
detail: Combines PMKVY, apprenticeship promotion, and Jan Shikshan Sansthan schemes.

title: Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana Expansion (TB Nutrition)
detail: Monthly support doubled to ₹1,000 per TB patient; nutritional supplements for underweight patients.

title: Union Budget 2025-26 — Tax Reforms
detail: New tax slabs: 100% rebate on income up to ₹12 lakh; enhanced TDS/TCS limits; fiscal deficit target 4.4% of GDP.

title: Unified Pension Scheme (UPS)
detail: Assured 50% pension of last-12-month average pay for 25+ years of service; inflation-indexed; govt contribution 14%→18.5%.

title: Ayushman Bharat Expansion to All Senior Citizens (70+)
detail: ₹5 lakh cashless hospitalisation for all 70+ citizens; additional ₹5 lakh for those already covered.

title: PMAY — Urban 2.0
detail: Financial assistance for 1 crore urban families; ₹2.5 lakh for construction, 4% interest subsidy, rental housing.

title: RBI Priority Sector Lending — Revised Directions
detail: UCB PSL target 60%; renewable energy loan limit ₹35 crore; transgenders added to weaker sections.

title: Income Tax Bill, 2025
detail: Replaces 1961 Act; expands search powers to virtual digital spaces; virtual digital assets as undisclosed income.

title: RBI Directions on Wilful & Large Defaulters
detail: Classification procedure for wilful defaulters (≥₹25 lakh); covers diversion of funds, siphoning.

title: IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance
detail: Supersedes 55 circulars; mandates coverage for all ages/conditions; cashless settlement within 1 hour.

title: RBI Directions for Asset Reconstruction Companies
detail: Minimum NOF ₹300 crore; mandatory security receipt rating within 6 months.

title: RBI — Housing Finance Company Framework Amended
detail: Deposit-accepting HFCs regulated at par with NBFCs.

title: RBI — P2P Lending Platform Directions Revised
detail: Platforms cannot assume credit risk; banned promoting P2P as assured-return investment.

title: SEBI — Mutual Fund & AMC Regulations
detail: New investment product (min ₹10 lakh); passive fund framework; anti-market-abuse mechanisms.

title: SEBI — SME Listing Framework Amended
detail: SMEs must show ₹1 crore operating profit in 2 of 3 previous years.

title: SEBI — FPI Disclosure Threshold Raised
detail: Disclosure threshold raised from ₹25,000 crore to ₹50,000 crore.

title: SEBI — Real-Time Price Data Sharing Norms
detail: Stock exchanges barred from sharing data with gaming/virtual-trading platforms.

title: SEBI — Bar on Association with Unregistered Advisors
detail: SEBI-regulated entities prohibited from association with unregistered advisory persons.

title: Cross-Border Equity Swaps Permitted
detail: FEMA rules amended; 100% FDI in white-label ATMs via automatic route.

title: SEBI — Cybersecurity & AI Frameworks
detail: Cybersecurity framework with data localisation; AI framework making entities responsible for outputs.

title: Banking Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2024
detail: Up to 4 nominees for bank deposits; fortnight redefined; cooperative bank director tenure raised to 10 years.

title: Offshore Mineral Conservation & Development Rules
detail: Mandatory exploration/production plans; buffer zones; no mining within 1 nautical mile of shore.

title: Offshore Mineral Trust & Auction Rules
detail: Production and composite licences via auction; 10% royalty to Trust Fund.

title: Boilers Bill, 2024
detail: Replaces 1923 Act; retains provisions for safe manufacture, installation, use of boilers.

title: Oilfields (Regulation & Development) Amendment Bill
detail: Expanded mineral oils definition; introduced petroleum lease; added penalties.

title: MSME Classification Thresholds Revised
detail: Investment/turnover limits raised — Micro: ₹2.5cr/₹10cr; Small: ₹25cr/₹100cr; Medium: ₹125cr/₹500cr.

title: TRAI — Telecom Infrastructure & Spectrum Sharing
detail: All passive/active infrastructure sharable; spectrum sharing with 2-year lock-in.

title: Aadhaar Authentication Rules Amended
detail: Added 'promoting ease of living' as purpose; non-government entities can propose uses.

title: CERC — Inter-State Transmission Licence Regulations
detail: Exemption for distribution licensees and bulk consumers; additional works under existing licences.

title: Cross-Border Electricity Trade Guidelines Amended
detail: Additional fuel sources for exports; export-oriented generators can sell domestically.

title: Bharatiya Vayuyan Vidheyak, 2024
detail: Replaces Aircraft Act, 1934; establishes DGCA, BCAS, AAIB; two-tier appellate mechanism.

title: Aircraft Security Rules Amended
detail: DG BCAS can refuse entry to aircraft; prohibition on false safety information.

title: Protection of Interests in Aircraft Objects Bill
detail: Implements Cape Town Convention; creditor remedies within 2 months on default.

title: Merchant Shipping Bill, 2024
detail: Mandatory registration for all vessels; relaxed ownership criteria to include OCIs.

title: Coastal Shipping Bill, 2024
detail: Coasting trade expanded to include services; Indian-owned vessels exempt from licence.

title: Bills of Lading Bill, 2024
detail: Replaces 1856 Act; retains bill of lading as conclusive evidence of goods.

title: Carriage of Goods by Sea Bill, 2024
detail: Replaces 1925 Act; retains Hague Rules framework.

title: Voluntary Vehicle Modernisation Programme
detail: Vehicle scrapping policy with scrapping facilities, automated testing, manufacturer discounts.

title: Public Liability Insurance Rules Amended
detail: Max insurer liability raised to ₹250 crore per accident; ₹5 lakh relief for death.

title: End-of-Life Vehicles Rules, 2025
detail: EPR obligations on producers; 8% steel scrapping target; environmental compensation.

title: UGC — Faculty & VC Appointment Draft Regulations
detail: VCs from industry/public policy; contract faculty 6-month cap.

title: RTE Rules Amended — Holding Back Students
detail: Students in classes 5 and 8 held back after failing re-exam; competency-based testing.

title: UGC PG Curriculum & Credit Framework
detail: Subject switching in PG; industry credits; exit with PG diploma after 1 year.

title: Uniform Code for Medical Device Marketing
detail: Prohibits unqualified 'safe' claims; brand reminders capped at ₹1,000; Ethics Committees.

title: TRAI — Broadcasting & Cable Tariff/QoS Amended
detail: NCF ceiling removed; DPO discounts raised to 45%; financial penalties.

title: Bombay HC Struck Down IT Rules (Fact Check Unit)
detail: Government FCU violates free speech (Art 19); terms 'false or misleading' vague.

title: Waqf (Amendment) Bill, 2024
detail: 5-year Muslim practice for waqf declaration; waqf-by-user removed; non-Muslims on Council/Boards.

title: Eighth Central Pay Commission Approved
detail: Constitution approved for central government employees; 7th Pay Commission expires 2026.

title: RBI — Small Finance Bank to Universal Bank Transition
detail: Voluntary path: 5-year track record, listed, ₹1,000 crore net worth, 2-year profitability.

title: SEBI — Same-Day Settlement Scope Expanded
detail: Optional T+0 settlement expanded from top 25 to top 500 companies by market cap.

title: Simultaneous Elections — 129th Constitutional Amendment Bill
detail: Synchronise Lok Sabha and all State Assembly elections; referred to JPC.

title: Union Territories Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2024
detail: Simultaneous elections for UT legislatures (Puducherry, Delhi, J&K).

title: Disaster Management (Amendment) Bill, 2024
detail: Urban Disaster Management Authorities and State Disaster Response Forces.

title: Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2025
detail: Consolidates 4 Acts; Bureau of Immigration; registration of foreigners.

title: Railways (Amendment) Bill, 2024
detail: Repeals Railway Board Act, 1905; incorporates into Railways Act, 1989.

title: Indian Ports Bill, 2025
detail: Maritime State Development Council; statutory State Maritime Boards; Dispute Resolution Committees.

title: TRAI — Regulatory Sandbox Framework
detail: Test environment for new digital services; 12-month permissions; DBN funding possible.

title: SC Upheld States' Power to Tax Mineral-Bearing Lands
detail: Royalty is not a tax; states can tax mineral lands; Parliament cannot limit states' taxing powers.

title: SC Struck Down Domicile Reservations in PG Medical
detail: Residence-based reservation in PG medical violates Art 14; state-quota PG seats on NEET merit.

title: SC Ruled Against Unilateral Arbitrator Appointment
detail: Government/PSUs cannot unilaterally appoint arbitrators; violates Art 14.

title: Draft National Sports Governance Bill, 2024
detail: Sports Regulatory Board of India; regulates NOC, NPC, NSFs; Appellate Sports Tribunal.

title: Goa ST Assembly Reservation Bill, 2024
detail: Reserve seats in Goa Assembly for Scheduled Tribes based on 2001 Census.

title: India-Bangladesh Border Monitoring Committee
detail: 5-member committee under ADG BSF to monitor border situation.

title: Tribhuvan Sahkari University Bill, 2025
detail: Establishes IRMA as Tribhuvan Sahkari University.

title: CBSE Draft — Two Board Exams per Year for Class X
detail: Two exam windows from 2026; results released together.
